latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor AI Gemini — AI-powered video editing made simple.

- Instantly edit videos by describing desired changes; Gemini AI performs cuts, transitions, and captioning automatically.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM formats.
- Cloud backend handles all editing, rendering, and export in 1–2 minutes for typical clips.
- Automatic session/token management, requiring no manual config after setup.
- Unified workflow for upload, edit instructions, preview, and export within a single session.
- Designed for creators and marketers who want fast, smart video edits without manual timelines.
